name: AG2
summary: Protocol-driven Python framework for cooperating agents, tool-calling loops, human-in-the-loop workflows and multi-agent orchestration.
description: Install ag2[openai] (PyPI ag2 1.3.0; Python 3.11+), then configure the chosen model provider. AG2 v1 uses the ag2 import namespace and is not a drop-in replacement for AG2 Classic. The older autogen namespace, ConversableAgent and GroupChat now live in ag2ai/ag2-classic. Tools can be plain Python functions decorated with @tool. Apache-2.0 framework; inference is separate.

agent_access.notes: Public source repository; local library. Model services and compute have separate requirements and costs.
